name: Can you just paint over a water stain on bathroom drywall?

mainEntity.name: Can you just paint over a water stain on bathroom drywall?

acceptedAnswer.text: Painting over water-stained bathroom drywall without fixing the source and properly sealing the board will fail quickly. Mineral stains bleed through standard latex paint within weeks, and damp gypsum continues to degrade underneath. Even if the underlying leak is dry, the affected drywall must be evaluated for softness, scraped clean, and sealed with an oil-based or stain-blocking primer before applying a moisture-resistant bathroom finish coat.
acceptedAnswer.description: No. Painting over water stains without resolving the moisture source and applying a dedicated stain-blocking primer leads to recurring discoloration, mold, and peeling paint.
